description:
• About our brand and products: Bikerringshop has been a trusted source for badass biker jewelry and accessories since 2004. We specialize in high-quality 925 Sterling Silver jewelry, including skull rings, heavy chain bracelets, pendants, and wallet chains. Beyond silver, we offer premium exotic leather goods crafted from genuine stingray, crocodile, and ostrich skin. Our style caters to bikers, rockers, goths, and anyone looking for bold, statement pieces that stand out from the crowd.

• What makes us different:

  • Authenticity Guaranteed: We use real .925 Sterling Silver. Our customers know they are getting the real deal, not cheap plated metal.

  • Handmade Craftsmanship: Most of our pieces are handcrafted with intricate details that mass-produced jewelry cannot match.

  • Heavy & Solid: Our jewelry is known for its weight and substance. We don't sell hollow or flimsy items; our customers love the "heavy" feel of our products.

  • Legacy: With over two decades of experience, we have a solid reputation in the biker community worldwide.

• How affiliates can earn:You will earn a competitive [XX]% commission on every sale generated through your unique affiliate link or coupon code.

  • High Average Order Value: Since our products are premium sterling silver and exotic leather, the order value is often high, resulting in significant earnings per sale for you.

  • Performance Bonuses: Top-performing affiliates may be eligible for higher commission tiers and exclusive perks.

• How to promote us:

  • Social Media: Create content on TikTok, Instagram (Reels/Stories), and YouTube. Short videos showcasing the shine, details, and weight of the jewelry work best.

  • Content Ideas: Unboxing videos, "How to style" biker jewelry with leather jackets/denim, or close-up reviews testing the silver quality.

  • Target Audience: Focus on Bikers, Harley-Davidson enthusiasts, Rock/Metal music fans, Gothic fashion lovers, and men’s accessories collectors.

  • Blogs/Websites: If you have a blog about motorcycle culture or men's alternative fashion, banner ads or review articles are highly effective.

• Other information:

  • Cookie Duration: 30 Days (You get credit if the customer buys within 30 days of clicking your link).

  • Payment: We pay commissions via PayPal.

  • Support: We provide high-quality product images and dedicated support to help you succeed.

  • Ads: "PPC bidding on our brand name (Bikerringshop) or misspellings is strictly prohibited. Commissions generated via Google Ads on brand keywords will be denied."
payout_period: Monthly (Payment sent on the 20th of the following month)
